liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Day Tripper** (3 reviews): Attendee calls the Day Tripper opener a high point of the ten-song first set; Attendee found the opener fun but loose, a better idea than execution [17][18][20]
- **Row Jimmy** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the Row Jimmy very emotional and heavy; Reviewer describes the Row Jimmy as juking and wild [14][20]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (2 reviews): Attendee found the Sugar Magnolia particularly memorable; Reviewer counts the Sugar Magnolia among the second set's best moments [18][19]
- **Playin' In The Band Reprise** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Playin' fans shouldn't miss this show; Despite a weak first set, reviewer admits the Playin' into Drums and Space is great [22][23]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Attendee names the Jack Straw into Might As Well set closer as a first-set highlight [17]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the China Cat to Rider transition and the Rider as second-set highlights [19]
- **Might as Well** (1 review): Reviewer was struck by Might As Well closing the first set [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd85-06-25 t01 Day Tripper**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd85-06-25 t02 West La Fadeaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd85-06-25 t03 CC Rider**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd85-06-25 t04 Dire Wolf**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd85-06-25 t05 Beat It On Down The Line**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd85-06-25 t06 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd85-06-25 t07 Me & My Uncle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **gd85-06-25 t08 Big River**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-06-25.142391.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 144 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1985-06-25.152625.akgc422-davis-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 22 songs; 144 min [3]
- **gd85-06-25.sbd.jeffm.3049.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 139 min; rated 4.18/5 by 28 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the sound quality of this Jeff copy sweet; Reviewer rates the soundboard excellent, but says its clarity exposes the band's sloppy moments [21][23]
- **gd85-06-25.sbd.miller.18663.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 138 min; rated 4/5 by 37 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer streamed both archive copies and found them about equally good-sounding [14]
- **gd1985-06-25.148520.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 138 min [9]

## Around the show

- Reviewer missed the show for work; friends returned enthusing about Day Tripper and China Doll [16]
- Recording is dedicated to the late Kenny Davis [3]
- Attendee prefers the Riverbend and Post shows from this tour, though still calls this one worth keeping [17]
- Reviewer thinks it's not as strong overall as the Merriweather show five nights later [19]
- Attendee recalls a high-energy show and rates it probably the best of that tour [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-06-25.142391.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassettes (dolby b) > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav… [1]. Also: A different soundboard source patches 0:33 of Big River and the last 1:24 of Sugar Magnolia [1]
- **gd1985-06-25.152625.akgc422-davis-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew; Kenny Davis, Sean Murtha, Tom Pinney, Eddie Wahba; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Microphones: AKG C422|AKG S42 XY 90º Cardioid Recorder: Sony TC-D5M [mic master] Location: Pavilion ~100' from stage 30' ROC (Sec 22 Row R) This Source: Master… [3]. Also: Third AKG C422 recording by the Executive Crew, with both capsules set omni, crossed at 90 degrees [3]
- **gd85-06-25.sbd.jeffm.3049.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Master Cassette> DAT> CDR> EAC> SHN [6]
- **gd85-06-25.sbd.miller.18663.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd1985-06-25.148520.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [9]. Also: Oade's Schoeps source supplies some crowd, a few Big Railroad Blues notes, and a 0:27 Drums patch [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Brian Baumwoll Grateful Dead: [1985-06-25 Blossom Music Center, Cuyahoga Falls, OH, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1985-06-25-blossom-music-center-cuyahoga-falls-oh-usa/) [27]
